subject: EchoHealth — follow-up: volume & founder credit checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood-inference.com>
To: Julia Cheng <julia@echohealth.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: EchoHealth — follow-up: volume & founder credit checklist

Thanks again for the time today, Julia — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

Summary from call
- Current pilot: ~25M tokens / month (NLP inference for triage flows)
- Expected production ramp: 25M -> 120M tokens / month over 12 months (50% MoM early growth, then linear)
- Target budget range you gave: $8k–$15k / month initially (this is helpful context for economics)

Pricing / discount asks you mentioned
- Founder / startup credits eligibility (EchoHealth is seed-stage per your note)
- Committed-use discount for a 12 or 24 month pricing path
- Desire for target $/1M tokens (you mentioned aiming for <$700 / 1M tokens)

What I need from you to model options (attached template):
- Confirm monthly token projection by month (the attached token_projection_template.csv)
- Procurement contact and legal timeline (procurement@echohealth.ai OK?)
- Any procurement constraints (POs only, net-30, prepay preferred?)

What we can do from Redwood (initial, non-binding):
- Startup Founders Credit: up to $25k in platform credit + 6 months of onboarding support (eligibility docs required)
- Committed-use tiers (examples below) — final price depends on exact monthly commit and payment cadence:
  * On-demand benchmark: $1,200 / 1M tokens (for reference)
  * 12-month commit (monthly billing): up to 40% off -> ~$720 / 1M tokens
  * 12-month prepay (annual invoice): up to 45% off -> ~$660 / 1M tokens
  * 24-month prepay / multi-year: up to 50% off -> ~$600 / 1M tokens

Suggested mutual action plan
1) You: upload the month-by-month projection to the template and confirm procurement contact (by Fri 11/13)
2) Us: finance to run committed pricing scenarios + legal to prepare a draft SOW & quote (by Mon 11/16)
3) If agreed: pilot credit applied and contract executed (target: by end of November)

Attachments: token_projection_template.csv (simple month-by-month), sample quote link to follow after projections

If the $/1M target you mentioned (sub-$700) is firm, call that out in your reply and we’ll prioritise the multi-year or prepay path in the quote.

Thanks — I’ll loop in finance and legal once you confirm the projection.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Redwood Inference — production-first inference for LLMs
From: Julia Cheng <julia@echohealth.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EchoHealth — follow-up: volume & founder credit checklist

Ben — thanks for the clear write-up. Confirming the projections and a few clarifications below. I attached our projection workbook (EchoHealth_Monthly_Projection_v1.xlsx).

Confirmed numbers (high level)
- Month 1 (pilot): 25M tokens
- Month 3: ~45M tokens
- Month 6: ~85M tokens
- Month 12: ~120M tokens

Budget notes
- Initial budget is constrained (~$8k/mo) but we have separate product initiative funding that unlocks in Q1 for growth spend
- Procurement: procurement@echohealth.ai (CC’d on this thread). Legal lead: Tanya Park (tanya.park@echohealth.ai)

Pricing ask
- We are pushing to hit a target closer to $650 / 1M tokens (not $700). If Redwood can get to ~$650 on a committed plan, we can likely accelerate a 12-month purchase and keep a healthy runway for growth.

Startup credits
- We are seed-stage (inc done 2025) — happy to share incorporation docs / cap table if needed for the founders credit.

Attachment: EchoHealth_Monthly_Projection_v1.xlsx

Julia Cheng
Head of Product | EchoHealth
julia@echohealth.ai | +1 (212) 555-0147
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood-inference.com>
To: Julia Cheng <julia@echohealth.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, procurement@echohealth.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EchoHealth — follow-up: volume & founder credit checklist

Appreciate the quick confirmation and the projection file, Julia — that helps a lot. I ran the numbers with Rishi (copied) and here are concrete scenarios we can present to Finance/RevOps for an official quote: 

Scenario A — 12-month commit (monthly billing)- Commit: average 85M tokens / month over the term (we can set a floor/ceiling in the contract)- Discount: 40% off on-demand -> price estimate: $720 / 1M tokens- Notes: minimal paperwork, standard SLA

Scenario B — 12-month prepay (annual invoice)- Commit: 12 months of expected spend prepay at a single invoice- Discount: 45% off -> price estimate: $660 / 1M tokens- Notes: finance prefers prepay for higher discounts; we can size the prepay to your Q1 unlock if helpful

Scenario C — Multi-year / 24-month prepay- Discount: up to 50% off -> ~$600 / 1M tokens- Notes: requires legal acceptance of term and finance sign-off for multi-year invoicing schedule

Startup Founders Credit
- We can apply an onboarding credit of $20k–$25k for eligible founders (requires incorporation docs + a short founders form). Credit is applied to first invoices and does not change committed rate but reduces net cash outlay during ramp.

Immediate asks from EchoHealth to proceed to formal quote
1) Confirm which pricing scenario you prefer (A/B/C) — if you want ~$650 / 1M, Scenario B or C is the best path.
2) Confirm procurement contact + PO/terms preference (prepay vs net-30)
3) Send incorporation doc or founders form for credit verification

Internal note on timeline: if we get confirmation by end of this week (11/13), finance + legal can generate a draft quote + SOW by 11/16. DocuSign route OK for signatures.

I’ll draft the MAPlist and send the sample quote link once finance runs final unit economics.

Onwards —
Ben
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EchoHealth — follow-up: volume & founder credit checklist

Quick internal: finance, can we approve up to 50% off for a 24-month prepay structure if legal signs standard T&Cs? I want to make sure we understand the cash cadence before committing the credit. Rishi — can you run a quick P&L for the scenarios Ben outlined and confirm whether we need revenue recognition exceptions for the prepay?

If procurement insists on $650 / 1M and they’re willing to prepay 12 months, that’s probably our fastest path to a closed-won this quarter.

Laura Bennett
Sales Manager, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
